note: K (`k`) — SMG / Attacker / Electric / Burst III (40s); ammo 120, reloadFrames 129, hitsPerShot 2, normalMult 9.1, coreMult 200, base crit 15%/critDmg 150%. A stack-and-dump burst DPS: she builds 'Tilted Scale' crit rate while firing her SMG, then her burst swaps to a slow 10-pellet electric shotgun for 10s. Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-02 (driver Qwen). MODEL — BURST (dominant damage): self weaponSwap (damagePct 925, pullsPerSec 2, durationSec 10) + self ATK 63.36% of caster (casterAtkPct) for 10s + self Attack Damage 21.12% for 10s, all on burstCast. The kit's burst weapon is 'Damage 92.5% of final ATK, Pelletcount 10, Attack speed ▼90%, 10s'. PELLETS COLLAPSED: the engine's weaponSwap fires ONE dealDamage per pull at damagePct for a non-SG base (effectivePellets is SG-only AND swap-off — src/engine/sim.ts:1386 — so a swap weapon cannot be granted 10 pellets via pelletCountFlat); the 10 pellets × 92.5% are therefore encoded as a single 925%-of-final-ATK hit per pull. This is EV-EXACT under the sim's deterministic (expected-value, no damage seed) crit model: 10 independent 92.5% crit rolls and 1 × 925% crit roll have identical expectation. What the collapse loses is per-pellet crit VARIANCE (not modeled) and the per-pellet crit COUNT that feeds S1c (which is UNMODELED anyway — see below). CADENCE: pullsPerSec 2 = the engine's frame-quantized SMG cadence (20.0/s, src/engine/sim.ts PULLS_PER_SEC) × 0.10 for the kit's 'Attack speed ▼90%'; over 10s = 20 pulls × 925% = 18,500% of final ATK before crit/buffs. Swap weapon range-band/core left at base SMG (the changed weapon's class is kit-silent; an SG-class guess would NOT activate pellet spray since effectivePellets keys off the BASE weapon — documented ⚑, second-order). SKILL1 (Tilted Scale → burst-window crit): self Critical Rate 75% for 10s on burstCast. The literal kit is a STACK RAMP — 'on firing the last bullet: Tilted Scale Critical Rate ▲0.75% continuously, stacks up to 100 times; Tilted Scale stacks ▲29' (i.e. +29 stacks = +21.75% crit per last-bullet fire, capping at 100 stacks = +75%), 'removed when Full Burst ends'. The engine has NO '+N stacks per trigger' primitive (buff apply is +1 stack/trigger, src/engine/sim.ts:1922) and NO Full-Burst-end buff-REMOVAL primitive, so the literal sawtooth (build over ~4 last-bullet fires ≈ 33s, wipe at FB end, rebuild) cannot be encoded. The LOAD-BEARING observable is K's crit rate DURING her burst window (the dominant damage source): at steady state she reaches the 100-stack cap (=75%) well before each burst cast (4 last-bullet fires × ~8.15s magazine cycle ≈ 33s < 40s CD), so 'burstCast self critRatePct 75% for 10s' is the faithful steady-state burst-window magnitude. The pre-burst-phase crit (on her modest 9.1%/pull SMG output) and the first-burst ramp (first cast lands before the cap) are under-credited — documented ⚑ below. SKILL2 (Fulfillment of Righteousness): all allies maxAmmoPct ▼51.13% + Attack Damage ▲10.62% for 10s, triggered on lastBullet. The kit trigger is 'when gaining Tilted Scale'; Tilted Scale is ONLY gained on firing the last bullet (skill1), so lastBullet is an EXACT proxy for the trigger (not an approximation). The 10s duration from a ~8.15s-cadence last-bullet fire gives near-continuous team uptime, matching the kit (the buff persists until FB end and is immediately re-applied on the next last bullet). 'Similar effects cannot be stacked' is satisfied by the engine's same-caster buff refresh/overwrite semantics. UNMODELED (honest residuals): (S1c) 'when pellets land a critical hit 4 times → 23.9% of final ATK as additional damage to the target' — the engine has NO crit-GATED hit counter (hitCount fires every N cumulative HITS, not every N CRITS; src/skills/types.ts TriggerDef), and the pellet-collapse above means the swap's per-pull hit count is not the real per-pellet count anyway, so a hitCount:4 proxy would be doubly unfaithful (counts non-crits AND wrong basis). Magnitude is secondary (~5% of burst-window damage at steady-state crit rate). (S1d/S2c) 'when Full Burst ends: removes Tilted Scale / removes Fulfillment of Righteousness' — no FB-end buff-removal primitive; moot for S2 (10s duration self-expires ≈ the FB window) and folded into the burstCast-10s Tilted Scale encoding for S1. Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-02.
